checks.name: Independent claim-history rebuild
checks.expect: claim rows equal a rebuild from claim ids + chunks, not the states file the loader read
checks.evidence: The event log tracks lineage events, but a claim state also opens when exact spelling, citation count, or section changes. Rebuilding from claim ids and chunk output covers those state changes independently.

checks.got: claim 52,994 rows, layout 6,088; fresh copy identical True; re-run loaded 0 pages, unchanged True
